messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — access-snapshot found ~62 principals with admin entitlements that are flagged to expire in 7d. needs triage :rotating_light:
own: Link? can you paste the list or dashboard?
maya: https://internal.redwood/ps/access-snap/2026-03-18 — filter=role:admin,expires<7d. attached CSV in the dashboard.
samir: Are these user admins or svc-acct keys too? KMS owners included?
maya: mixed. ~10 are service accounts, 4 are KMS key-admin bindings. rest are people with project-level admin.
security-bot: Automated note: risk_score=HIGH for 4 principals (kms_key_admin, service-account-token-create). Evidence: recent token usage detected.
owen: For the svc-accts — do we have an owners label or custodian? if not, we should quarantine instead of full revoke.
maya: Owners missing for 6 svc-accts. Proposed plan: 1) open a short justification window (72h) for owners to claim + provide justification; 2) canary removal of 12 random user-admins (non-prod) for 48h; 3) immediate lock for any svc-acct with kms_key_admin and no owner.
samir: For KMS owners: if we lock a principal that is used in runtime, need rollback steps. suggest we snapshot KMS access logs first and push an allowlist for the service path.
ops-oncall: If we revoke a token mid-shift we need a rollback runbook. put this in the ticket: command snippets, monitoring queries, and playbook.
maya: Draft runbook snippet: ```gcloud iam roles remove --project=$PROJ --member="serviceAccount:NAME@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com" roles.editor``` and for KMS binding: ```gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding KEY --member="serviceAccount:NAME@..." --role="roles/cloudkms.admin"```
owen: Add audit query to watch for sudden errors: ```resource.type="k8s_container" protoPayload.status.code!=0 OR protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail: ("svc-" OR "bot-")``` also KMS specific: ```resource.type="kms_key" protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"serviceAccount:"```
security-bot: Scan output attached: CSV and summary id=scan-20260318-1719. Found 3 principals with recent (last 24h) KMS ops.
ciso: Pause any blanket removals on roles:project-owner and roles/owner for production projects until we confirm fallback routes. prioritize removing unused human admins and orphaned service accounts.
maya: Agreed. we'll carve prod projects out of the canary. canary subset = dev/staging projects only.
owen: Who will open the ticket and assign owner outreach?
maya: I'll open a JIRA: REDWOODSEC-3482 and tag infra-owners + security. text: "Expiring privileges sweep: 62 principals flagged; 72h justification window; canary in dev/stage; immediate svc-acct lock for unowned KMS-admins."
samir: Add a step to create a short-lived keypair or fallback service-account with limited perms and document env var swap for apps using the old key. that reduces blast radius.
ops-oncall: Scheduling note — we'll run the canary revoke tomorrow 10:00 PT, monitor for 48h, then proceed to bulk if no regressions. I'll create the PagerDuty ops playbook and add escalation rules.
maya: Action items in ticket: CSV + owners list + runbook snippets + audit queries + rollback commands + list of excluded prod projects. owners have 72h to respond or we remove.
security-bot: Reminder scheduled: notify-owners job will send nudge at 24h and 48h automatically.
ciso: Make sure KMS audit is archived and tied to compliance folder (SOX/PCI). Also require that any restored entitlements pass a secondary approval in the console.
owen: +1. I'll volunteer to review justification payloads for 24h window.
maya: Thanks. I'll post updates in #eng-security and attach the ticket. :white_check_mark:
